Deadlock gameplay drives your Spotify. When nothing's happening the track sits back: quieter, near-mono,
with the drums, vocals and bassline stripped out. As the fight builds, the stems come back in and the
track opens up to full width and level. Shots pump the low end, getting hit muffles it, dying drops it
underwater, kills hit like a drop.

**Features**
- Real-time neural stem separation on your GPU (drums, vocals, music, bass)
- Energy that builds from moving, fighting, shooting, hits and kills, and brings the stems back in
- Per-event moves: shot pump, hit muffle, death underwater, kill drop, objectives, ults
- Settings window with presets, intensity and an effects A/B switch; lives in the tray
- Client-side only: works in normal matchmaking, no memory reading

**Requirements**
- Windows 10/11 with a DirectX 12 GPU
- The Spotify desktop app
- Deadlock with the included hook addon and `-netconport 29000 -condebug`

**About this mod**
Built with heavy AI assistance (Claude). Tested offline and in matches by the author; some parts
(kill counting, neural stems under a real match) are still being confirmed. Bug reports welcome.
